CheckTitle: EBS snapshots with Public Access enabled
Description: Public access for EBS Snapshots is not blocked at the account level to prevent accidental public sharing.
Risk: Without the block public access feature enabled globally, users with appropriate IAM permissions can accidentally or maliciously share an EBS snapshot publicly, increasing the risk of a data breach.

Recommendation.Text: Enable 'Block Public Access for EBS Snapshots' (set to 'block-all-sharing') in your EC2 settings for the region. This acts as a global safeguard to ensure no snapshot can be made public, regardless of individual snapshot permissions, but does not affect snapshots that have already been publicly shared.
